brief_summary: Horizontal bar chart of passage completion time at trial five from the 2009 Human Factors learning-curve study, against a 40-second QWERTY baseline: split fixed-angle 42 s, contoured split 69 s, Dvorak 181 s, chord 346 s. The two split designs are filled in dusty rose and bracketed as 'physical relearning'; Dvorak and chord are outlined in warm-grey and bracketed as 'cognitive relearning'. A right-hand column lists each design's learning percentage (90.4, 76.9, 79.1, 77.3).
